# SonoJS

> React components, blocks, charts, and cursors for Tailwind apps. Add with the SonoJS CLI or generate UI via MCP.

SonoJS (https://sonojs.com) is the public docs and catalog for a copy-source React UI library. Browse primitives and blocks on the site, install files with `npx @sonojs/ui@latest add <name>`, or connect an MCP client for agent-driven installs.

## Catalog

- Components and guides: https://sonojs.com/docs
- UI blocks: https://sonojs.com/blocks
- Charts: https://sonojs.com/charts
- Cursors: https://sonojs.com/cursors
- Backgrounds: https://sonojs.com/backgrounds
- AI components: https://sonojs.com/ai
- 3D scenes: https://sonojs.com/3d
- Templates: https://sonojs.com/templates
- Website packs: https://sonojs.com/websites
- Tools: https://sonojs.com/tools

## Setup

- Installation: https://sonojs.com/docs/installation
- CLI: https://sonojs.com/docs/cli
- MCP server: https://sonojs.com/docs/mcp
- Direction (RTL / LTR): https://sonojs.com/docs/direction

## Registry (machine-readable)

- Registry index: https://sonojs.com/r/registry.json
- Per-item JSON: https://sonojs.com/r/<item-name>.json
